name: 54220 · Manitowoc, WI
findings: ZIP 54220 (Manitowoc) has 153 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54220 (Manitowoc) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 54220 (Manitowoc) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
